description: Lookback attention (24 heads) + MLP word detectors for hand-written sentiment lexicon with negation phrases, uniform pooling of polarity, sign -> 0/1.
v1 + prefix-stem word detectors and 'but/however' contrast flag (attn+MLP) that upweights later-clause polarity in the final attention pooling.
v2 + expanded hand-written lexicon/stems and intensifier phrases ('very X' -> 1.5x).
v3 + negation across one filler word ('not a good', "n't very funny"), 28-char lookback, vectorized weight writing.
